description: Close your workspace and free its runner slot. state "closing" means the runner could not be reached yet and the reaper will finish the job.

context.description: Context name. Omit to use the default.

delete.description: Host-mode fleets: also delete the session directory and everything in it. DESTRUCTIVE: set it only when the user asked for it. Without it the directory is kept and reattached on the next open.

fleet.description: Fleet name. Omit to use the default.

workspace.description: Workspace id. Omit to use this session's workspace on the fleet.

name: workspace_close
